name: COMP_061
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (75%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section with Benign, InSitu, and Invasive in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 75%, InSitu 10%, Benign 9%, Normal 6% | Favors Invasive; 5% test ECE |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude Benign or InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 94% reliability, 68th OOD percentile [F6] | Unflagged input; 70% error AUROC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent models match top call |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Invasive (20%) [F5]; closest InSitu (89%) | Weak neighbor consensus across classes |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 4, 5) · context · Above-typical score (contribution -0.88) [F2]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive driver (+0.85) [F3]; 19/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Pulls against invasive (-0.84) [F4]; failed 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasive (+0.73); weak with 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Pulls against invasive (-0.31); 20/20 AI spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing 3 top-risk regions drops risk above random (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); uses Unreliable normal lobules, mitoses, and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions represent in situ carcinoma (closest match BACH_0339, 89% similarity) or benign atypia without stromal invasion.
- Simulated composite layout (low-risk left half, high-risk right half) or frozen-section artifact distorts probabilities and margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 11**: Confirm stromal invasion versus in situ lesion; verify mitoses and necrosis manually.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 10, 11**: Check superior (430 um), lateral (645 um), and inferior (323 um) margins [F7].
3. **Regions 0, 4, 5, 8, 9**: Confirm benign lobules and TILs; assess drafted deeper levels order.
